race.comment: DIAMOND SHOW (10) ended a run of three minor placings with a comfortable victory over 2060m here 17 days ago. Hit the line full of running that day which suggests a first try at this distance won't be a bother. Up in class but at the weights is a winning hope again. FERNAO (2) met with good support but couldn't pick up Felix The Scat over this course and distance last weekend. Drops in grade and the claim brings him in okay. Looks ready to win. CORMAC T (6) came to Brisbane and broke a run of outs with a tough on-pace win here at this distance recently. Tackles a better field this time but drops 2.5kgs and should give backers a sight again. CAPTAIN MAVERICK (7) has gone around at $5.50 or shorter in his last five races without success. Placed at three of four over this trip so certainly one for the exotics.
